title: BNCI 2022-001 EEG Correlates of Difficulty Level dataset
description: EEG recordings from 13 healthy participants who piloted a simulated drone through circular waypoints at varying difficulty levels using a joystick. The dataset includes an offline session with a v-shaped difficulty design and two online sessions in which subjective difficulty was decoded from EEG to support closed-loop adaptation of task difficulty. Data were recorded with a 64-channel Biosemi ActiveTwo system and are provided preprocessed in BIDS format via the MOABB collection (BNCI 2022-001).
methods_description: 64-channel EEG (Biosemi ActiveTwo, 10-10 montage, plus 3 EOG channels) was recorded at 2048 Hz and downsampled to 256 Hz. Preprocessing comprised 1-40 Hz Butterworth bandpass filtering, SPHARA spatial low-pass filtering, common-average referencing, ICA-based EOG removal, and amplitude-threshold artifact rejection. Participants completed an offline session of 32 trajectories with constant difficulty, followed by online sessions of 12 trajectories per condition in which difficulty was adapted using an EEG decoder (LDA or elastic-net GLM on log-PSD features) or by the subject.

funding_references.funder_name: Swiss National Centres of Competence in Research (NCCR) Robotics
